title: Work orders Delete lets the user delete work orders
preconds: 1. A user has a role with Work orders View, Create & Edit and Delete.
steps:
1. Log in and open a non-critical work order.
  2. Click the Delete action.
  3. Confirm.
  4. Return to the list.
expected:
The Delete action is shown.

A confirmation dialog appears.

The deleted work order is gone from the list.
